title: teaching grandmother how to play chess

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: No, knights can go over pawns.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: So are you teaching me chess?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yeah, knights can go over pawns, like gallop, gallop, left or right, you can choose it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Okay, so is it Grandma's turn?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yeah, it's your turn.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: So what do I do?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Move anything you want.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: But I can only go 1 space, right? Because so now it's a checkmate already. How is it a checkmate already?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Look, gang, gang, gang, I can't get you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Not if I do that.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You can't go that way.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I can't go to the side.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Pawns can only go front or in diagonal to capture. So you can't do that.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Okay, so I'm gonna go like that.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Well, back in my day, we just played that any piece could move a square to the side if it was blocked. It makes the game much faster.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: But that’s not how the actual rules work, Grandma! You can't just change how the pieces move because you're bored, it ruins the whole strategy.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Grandma, you can move your B ship somewhere because it's open. Grandma can eat you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Yeah, let me get you. Thank you, Mommy, for helping me.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: So I'm gonna move. Gallop, gallop. Left or right?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: He— how's— how is he able to gallop that much?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Gallop.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: No, don't be cheating.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Gallop, gallop. Left or right? I choose right.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: He can gallop like that?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yeah, it goes in Ls.
